item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=quantum+information+scrambling+decoherence+redundant+records+operator+growth+experiment&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Finite-Capacity Thermodynamics of Causal Horizons.\", \"abstract\": \"This work proposes that fundamental physics remains unchanged, but its local classical representability is limited by the finite entropic capacity of causal horizons. Geometric entanglement entropy is treated as a thermodynamic potential, and horizons as finite-capacity information systems. When this capacity is saturated, local semiclassical descriptions break down without affecting underlying unitary dynamics. This defines a representational, not dynamical, transition, where configurations persist but cannot be locally encoded.
